description: Sanity-check a policy spec without making any decision. Catches: empty allow list, overly broad "*" wildcards, malformed host patterns containing schemes/paths/queries.

policy.description: A simplified network policy. Use { allow: ["api.openai.com", "*.example.com"] }. Optional: deny: string[], methods: string[].

allow.description: Host patterns to allow. Supports exact and *.suffix wildcards.

deny.description: Host patterns to deny. Wins over allow.

methods.description: HTTP methods to permit (e.g. ["GET", "POST"]). Default any.

name: validate_policy
